primary_endpoint: Change in intrahepatic triglycerides quantified by ¹H-MRS at 24 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: IHTG decreased 8.7% with lanifibranor versus 3.0% with placebo at 24 weeks; statistical significance was not reported.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events occurred in 1/20 participants receiving lanifibranor and 0/18 receiving placebo; no deaths.
